mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employee_language el WHERE el.employee_id = (SELECT employee_id from employee e where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_language( languageName, readingLevel, writingLevel, speakingLevel, testName, testScore, issuedDate, issuer ) VALUES ( #{languageName}, #{readingLevel}, #{writingLevel}, #{speakingLevel}, #{testName}, #{testScore}, #{issuedDate}, #{issuer}, )
